name: m-claude-plugins
description: Plugin framework for Claude Code — self-learning AI manager with determinism, delegation, and evolution

plugins.name: learn
plugins.description: Capture session learnings as rules, skills, or CLAUDE.local.md updates; /init bootstrap + updater agent

plugins.name: init
plugins.description: Set up a project's documentation structure — docs/, CLAUDE.md index, AGENT.md

plugins.name: update
plugins.description: Keep documentation in sync with code changes

plugins.name: brainstorm
plugins.description: Deep brainstorming through structured interview → spec document

plugins.name: lead-research
plugins.description: Multi-agent research — orchestrator spawns parallel subagents, synthesizes, cites

plugins.name: worktree-flow
plugins.description: Parallel Claude Code agents on native git worktrees — spawn, run, merge

plugins.name: scion
plugins.description: Skills for agents in a scion mesh — the template is the agent's persistent memory: learn into it, not into the ephemeral home

plugins.name: tg-report
plugins.description: Agents report to Telegram — a short summary on task completion, the full answer attached when it carries more

plugins.name: mcp-installer
plugins.description: Find an MCP server for a task and install it via the current harness's native mechanism — always with confirmation before install
